rule_outs: Dwelling 8 m from the best section
summary: Quiet south kerb with houses 8-10 m from every stretch of it.
reasons: Dwellings 8-10 m away on own side
Garage and shed directly beside kerb
Homes all round, no parking convention

drivers.seclusion: Houses sit 9 m away at 15 m and 8 m away at 33 m, with the shed and garage 4 m off; homes also face it from the north at 15-18 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb, room beside the lane for a van; no gate.
drivers.convention: No signs and almost no parked cars; a van would stand out.

flags: Dwelling within about 10 m of the best section
Slope about 2.5% here, max 6.8% near the end
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees to the north side give some morning shade, afternoon sun from the west.
cannot_judge: Exact house frontages in tree cover

best_section.where: South kerb of Hillman Street, between the garage and the shed frontages
